definitions.explanation: Fleeing one's own country for political reasons and seeking refuge in another country. Also refers to the state of living in exile.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{海外|かいがい}に{亡命|ぼうめい}した。
{政治的|せいじてき}な{理由|りゆう}で{亡命|ぼうめい}を{求|もと}めた。
examples.english: He sought asylum for political reasons.

examples.japanese: {独裁|どくさい}{政権|せいけん}から{逃|のが}れるために{多|おお}くの{知識人|ちしきじん}が{隣国|りんこく}に{亡命|ぼうめい}した。
examples.english: Many intellectuals defected to neighboring countries to escape the dictatorship.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {亡命|ぼうめい}する (to go into exile, to defect)
- {亡命|ぼうめい}{者|しゃ} (exile, defector, refugee)
- {亡命|ぼうめい}{政府|せいふ} (government in exile)
- {亡命|ぼうめい}を{求|もと}める (to seek asylum)
- {政治|せいじ}{亡命|ぼうめい} (political exile)

The characters literally mean "{亡|ぼう}" (to flee/perish) + "{命|めい}" (life/fate), conveying the sense of fleeing to save one's life.
